    • hasEmptySlot

      public MenuSnapshotAssert hasEmptySlot(int slot)
      Checks that no non-air item was observed at a slot.

      The snapshot does not expose capacity, so an empty slot does not establish upper-bound validity.

      Parameters:
      slot - Nonnegative slot index.
      Returns:
      This assertion.
